name: apple-videotoolbox
title: AppleGVA video decoder (VideoToolbox, macOS guest)
description: Paravirtual VideoToolbox device for a macOS guest with the apple-virgl video kext: the guest's H.264 and HEVC streams are decoded on this node's GPU (NVDEC or VA-API). Add it next to the VM's uniq-vgpu GPU: it meets the GPU at the mapper bridge /pvg-mapper-bridge (uniq-vgpu's default), through which decoded frames land in the GPU's surfaces; for several such VMs on one node give both sidecars the same VM-scoped PVG_MAPPER_BRIDGE_SHM, e.g. /uniqvgpu-{vmid}-mapper. Without the kext the device stays unclaimed and the guest decodes in software. The device has no display. qdevctl shares the VM's memory for it.
